The consortium dedicated to developing measurement science for artificial intelligence announced an expansion of its scope and a call for new members. Established two years ago with more than two hundred organizations, the group brings together industry, academia, government, and civil society to develop shared methods for evaluating AI systems. The expanded charter adds working groups on agent reliability, secure deployment, and the evaluation of generative models in sensitive domains. Organizations interested in joining may submit applications through the institute’s website; membership is open to US-based and international entities that meet participation requirements. “Rigorous evaluation is the foundation of trustworthy AI,” said the program director. The consortium will hold its next plenary in the spring and will publish interim guidance drafts for public comment beforehand.
